Jobs at RGU

Join us at our beautiful riverside campus and experience an inclusive, innovative environment, where everyone contributes to delivering impactful education and research.
Our Diverse Workforce

RGU strives towards creating a working, learning and social atmosphere which is inclusive, harmonious and respectful of diversity.
Rewards & Benefits

We want everyone to find their own work/life balance and offer a 35 hour week, hybrid working for most roles, flexible working and 46 days annual leave.
